__type.description: data type name of the record; selects the schema used to validate data

__ver.description: version of the schema named by __type that the data is validated against, in xxx.xxx.xxx form; e.g. __type=schema with __ver=0.0.1 means this is a schema record validated by schema-of-schema 0.0.1

data.description: record payload, validated against version __ver of the schema named by __type

data.name: schema
data.description: schema of schema; also defines the schema upgrade contract: a schema is changed only by POSTing a new version of the same __id, never by PUT or PATCH

name.description: data type name; required at the schema root and must equal the schema record __id, optional on a definition where it must equal the definition key

version.description: version of the schema of the data type defined by this record, in xxx.xxx.xxx form; required at the schema root, optional on a definition. it must be strictly higher than the version currently registered under the same __id: on upgrade the current version is archived as <type>__<old version>, archived ids cannot be POSTed directly, and records that declare the older __ver keep validating against that archived schema. the schema record's own __ver is the version of this schema of schema, not data.version; a data record's __ver is the version of its type's schema current when it was written, and with the No-Record-Framework header the Data Service rebuilds the record at the current version

description.description: human readable description of the data type

key.description: template that builds the record id from data attributes, e.g. vm-{name}; when set, __id must equal the built value. definitions use it to build the index key of nested objects

additionalProperties.description: whether a record may carry attributes not declared in properties; defaults to true when omitted

required.description: names of attributes that must be present in every record; recomputed during schema preprocessing from each property's required flag, do not author it directly

properties.description: map of attribute name to its definition

definitions.description: named reusable definitions referenced from properties via $ref, e.g. #/definitions/nic

type.description: attribute value type: string, integer, number, boolean, array, object, or map (an object used as a free-form hash)

items.description: definition of array elements; for type=map, the definition of map values

additionalProperties.description: definition of the entries of a free-form object/map; produced from a map's items during preprocessing

$ref.description: reference to a definition in the same schema, e.g. #/definitions/nic

contentMediaType.description: cross-type reference marker; only inventory/{type} is accepted, requires type=string, and the value must be the id of an existing record of that type

indexTemplate.description: template that auto-fills this attribute on records of the referenced type when they are created

required.description: whether the attribute must be present in every record; defaults to true when omitted

description.description: human readable description of the attribute

dataType.description: data type whose change history this journal page tracks

dataId.description: id of the record whose change history this journal page tracks

idx.description: journal page number; each page holds up to MaxEntryPerPage change entries

active.description: change entries not yet consumed by subscribers/processors

archived.description: change entries already consumed by subscribers/processors

page.description: journal page number this entry belongs to

idx.description: position of the entry within its page

time.description: timestamp recorded when the change happened

before.description: full record envelope before the change; absent when the record was created

after.description: full record envelope after the change; absent when the record was deleted

dataType.description: target data type whose records receive the auto-filled reference index

cmtSubscriber.description: map keyed by the referencing data type name; each entry describes how that type subscribes to this type

dataType.description: name of the referencing (subscriber) data type

versionIndex.description: map keyed by subscriber schema version; each version may declare its own index templates

version.description: subscriber schema version this index applies to

indexTemplate.description: attribute paths to maintain on records of the target type for this subscriber version
